summary.name: 腾讯混元 (Tencent Hunyuan)
summary.one_liner: Tencent's Hunyuan AI hub that lists its LLM and multimodal models (Hy3, Hy Vision 2.0, Hy Image3.5 preview) and research work on RL batch size scaling, learning-rate heuristics, and the Hyra research agent.
use_cases: try a large language model for coding and reasoning
read research on RL training efficiency
explore learning rate scheduling for LLM pretraining
summary.what_it_does: The page is a landing hub from Tencent's Hunyuan team. It lists several models: Hy3, a 295B/21B MoE model with 256K context and three thinking modes aimed at code, long text, reasoning and agent workflows; Hy Vision 2.0, a vision-understanding model built on HY-2.0 LLM for general image-to-text tasks; and Hy Image3.5 preview, an image generator noted for text rendering and style consistency. It also links research summaries: batch size scaling for RL training of LLMs (reporting up to 2.29x generation throughput gain and 29% less wall-clock time to a validation target with GRPO), the Effective Learning Rate (ELR) heuristic for pretraining dynamics, and Hyra-1.0, a self-improving research agent. Page text gives no pricing details.
notable: Hy3 is a 295B total / 21B active MoE model with 256K context and three thinking modes
Hyra (Hunyuan Research Agent) is described as recursively self-improving for research and engineering tasks
Research on RL batch size scaling reports up to 2.29x generation throughput and 29% faster time-to-target with GRPO on fixed GPUs
caveats: Pricing and access tiers are not stated on the page; '立即试用' (try now) links are the only access cues
Model performance claims are the team's own reported results
